$comment: Every direct dependency, with why we need it (ADR 0006). `bun run check` fails if package.json has a package that isn't listed here, or this lists one package.json doesn't have. `bun run deps:health` runs ADR 0006's health checks on added or changed packages; `exceptions` allows a named failing check (scorecard, recent-release, maintainers, install-scripts, license) and says why. Changing this file needs a code owner's approval.

@types/bun.reason: Types for bun:test and Bun's APIs, pinned to the packageManager Bun version.

exceptions.maintainers: One npm maintainer: the DefinitelyTyped publishing account. Types only, never runs.

@types/node.reason: Types for the node: modules the check scripts use.

exceptions.maintainers: One npm maintainer: the DefinitelyTyped publishing account. Types only, never runs.

typescript.reason: Type checking; pinned to 6.x for typescript-eslint (ADR 0007).

knip.reason: Finds unused files, exports and dependencies, and dependencies used but not declared. Agents leave all four behind.

exceptions.maintainers: One npm maintainer (webpro). Dev-only, no install scripts, ISC.
exceptions.scorecard: deps.dev publishes no OpenSSF Scorecard for webpro-nl/knip. Dev-only, no install scripts, actively released.

notes: ESLint and typescript-eslint together add about 90 packages, over ADR 0006's warning level of 20. Accepted in ADR 0007: type-aware linting is the main deterministic guard against bad agent code. The app itself has no runtime dependencies (ADR 0005).
